about: Copy to connector.local.json (git ignores it) and fill in. `npm run setup` sends these to the Worker as secrets; nothing here is ever committed or printed.
account_id: the Cloudflare account id (dashboard, Workers & Pages, right-hand column)
folder_id: the Drive id of the records folder, the one holding household.json
time_zone: the IANA time zone of the household's dates, for what is past due (UTC if left out)
